d:
Acquired from the storage sale of the mangaka and software developer Yuuji Iwaki, creator of L.L. Palace and Palacesoft. This particular work is a rather saucy doujinshi by Osamu Dezaki's wife, the mangaka Rikako Kugayama, created and sold at Comiket 50 as well as being distributed via Iwaki's mail order distribution service.

This in particular is the personal magazine that was distributed with the text "Anno O..." as well as for those who purchased the book via LL Palace. You can read it here:

https://e-hentai.org/g/3671102/e13b5feaf2/

Simply put, its a pamphlet and not much else, but this particular work was a one shot. Its not a part of the mainline work itself, thus it was uploaded separately.

I deem these sorts of works "animator's doujinshi" as they are by animators specifically or are aligned with animators closely. Kugayama worked extensively on Manga Nippon Mukashibanashi, and while I can't confirm it directly, some sources say that she did in-between animation at Gainax on Evangelion itself.
